notes.subject: pes bilong Yahwe
notes.rationale: ופני יהוה חליתי literally 'I have not rubbed/entreated the face of Yahwe' — idiom for seeking favor, rendered as asking favor

notes.subject: holim strong bel bilong mi
notes.rationale: ואתאפק 'I forced myself / restrained myself' — KJV 'I forced myself', YLT 'I force myself'; reflexive of אפק 'to contain'

notes.subject: sakrifais bilong karamapim
notes.rationale: עלה is the 'ascending' offering; the going-up picture is kept with 'karamapim'

translation: na mi tok: Nau ol Pelisit bai i kamdaun long mi long Gilgal, na pes bilong Yahwe mi no bin askim gutpela yet; na mi holim strong bel bilong mi, na mi salim karamap sakrifais bilong karamapim.

tokens.gloss: na mi holim strong bel bilong mi
